publicReleaseNotes: Uptime 0.5.13 fixes console pages stalling on Loading after repeated visits by increasing the separate static-resource allowance. Fingerprinted production JS/CSS build assets cache for one year; stable public filenames revalidate after one minute. Rate-limited reads explain the refusal, keep health Unknown and wait for Retry-After; refused actions are never automatically replayed. Unjoined locations can renew their one-time join command, and local commands use rer's installed runtime. Named monitor dependencies, readable change previews, backup restore feedback, second-factor removal confirmation, erasure references, maintenance cancellation and failure snapshot explanations improve everyday operations. Local invitations give the invited account's rer dev --as command; keep its printed link private. The heartbeat wrapper can use rer's runtime when Node is absent from PATH. Verify push shards account for observed agent and archive journey times. No migration or new required settings; monitors, history, incidents, destinations and private settings are kept on upgrade. Back up first, retain private settings and .rer/deploy separately, update with pnpm install --frozen-lockfile, then deploy as usual; see CHANGELOG for verified-session backup steps. The exact @runeditrun/rer pin stays at 0.2.113: native production setup still requires a mail provider and verified sender, so this release does not provide mail-off installation. Earlier known issues and upgrade cautions remain, including old heartbeat output, UptimeRobot monitor CSV import, erased-people restore, empty company decision feeds, the 64 KiB response-body bound and unestablished large-scale archive operation. The product screenshot was taken on 0.4.0, before the console changes of 0.5.0 through 0.5.13. Product screenshot: .github/assets/release/uptime-0.4.0-monitor-1440.png
